source.name: Wanted Design System Community
source.inspectionMethod: Figma MCP metadata and use_figma page-section inspection
limitations: Figma MCP Starter plan rate limit stopped subsection title extraction during this pass.
Rows with status `partial` or `needs-detail-audit` require a later node-level pass before they can be treated as complete.

statusLegend.covered: The WDS section has an LDS story, token, component, or document contract that directly covers the same design-system role.
statusLegend.theme-overridden: The WDS role is intentionally retained, but color, logo, or brand expression is replaced by LK ROBOTICS theme values.
statusLegend.partial: The LDS has relevant coverage, but the WDS node-level variants or examples have not all been verified.
statusLegend.needs-detail-audit: The top-level WDS section is known, but exact subsection-level coverage still needs Figma node extraction.
statusLegend.not-covered: No LDS coverage has been identified.

sections.notes: Closed against the accepted local .fig snapshot (acceptance decision 2026-07-08): all 339 WDS icon SVGs are imported with 1:1 variant-name mapping (kebab-case renames; navigationX -> nav-*). logoGoogle is intentionally served through BrandLogo; 18 lds-legacy robotics glyphs are LK product extensions.

Closed against the accepted local .fig snapshot (acceptance decision 2026-07-08): WDS Color/Variant/symbol roles map to Lockup tone (ink/white/brand) and variant (inline/stacked/mark). Language and Partnership sections are intentionally excluded for the single-language LK brand; stories do not claim Wanted visual parity. Follow-up: document an explicit clear-space rule in Brand stories.

Closed against the accepted local .fig snapshot (acceptance decision 2026-07-08): the WDS Basic node contains only the Ratio section; all 17 Aspect Ratio presets plus the 4-value vertical Ratio resource map 1:1 to --ratio-* tokens and FoundationBasic#RatioTokens. Color/typography Basic-adjacent content lives on Foundation guideline pages tracked by their own FOUNDATION_AUDIT rows.

Closed against the accepted local .fig snapshot (acceptance decision 2026-07-08): the WDS Spacing node is Safe Area only (Status/Bottom x Platform). iOS minima (44/34) and web env() insets are tokenized and demonstrated in FoundationSpacing; Android fixed constants (36/14) are intentionally not tokenized for the web runtime.

Closed against the accepted local .fig snapshot (acceptance decision 2026-07-08): WDS Decorate contains exactly Gradient (Solid/Multiple/Mask x 4 directions) and Interaction (4 states + layer variants), all mapped to --decorate-* and --interaction-* tokens with the FoundationDecorate (Effects) and FoundationInteraction stories. The Interaction Size axis is a Figma resource-swatch property with no token counterpart needed.

Closed against the accepted local .fig snapshot (acceptance decision 2026-07-08): Layout contains only Essential (system bars) and Divider, mapped to MobileSystemBars and Divider with LayoutEssentials#MobileSystemBarsByPlatform and LayoutDivider#DividerVariants evidence. LK overrides recorded: thick divider 8px (WDS 12px), iOS bar metrics used for both platforms. The Resource section is Figma doc tooling (excluded); PageHeader stays a product extension.

Closed against the accepted local .fig snapshot (acceptance decision 2026-07-08): all six Action children map to ActionArea, Button, TextButton, IconButton, Chip, ToggleIcon with exact size parity (Button 48/40/32, TextButton 32/28, IconButton 40/32/28, Chip 40/36/32/24) and the Disable->disabled, Active->pressed/selected rule applied. Recorded LK deviations: no chromeless IconButton "normal"; TextButton icons via composition. Follow-ups: focus-visible styling evidence and ActionArea sticky/compact/divider-false story demos.

Closed against the accepted local .fig snapshot (acceptance decision 2026-07-08): Textinput, Select, Control, Segmented Control, and Framed Style map to LDS props/stories axis-by-axis. Timer/Character Counter variants remain slot compositions; Android platform values are API-parity-only. DateTime/ColorSwatch/PinInput/FileUpload are confirmed absent from WDS sections, so their product-extension classification stands.

Closed against the accepted local .fig snapshot (acceptance decision 2026-07-08): Icon, Content Badge, Thumbnail (17 ratio presets exact), Avatar (sizes 24-56 exact), and List Cell (141 variants, px-exact padding) map axis-complete; Card covers platform/save/skeleton/top-bottom-content. Avatar "Official/원티드" badge variants are Wanted-brand assets intentionally excluded and LK-brand-replaced. Follow-ups: Card toggleIcon and third caption tier, thumbnailOverlay-inside-Card story.

Closed against the accepted local .fig snapshot (acceptance decision 2026-07-08): Wanted/Circular loading, Skeleton Text Align x Color x Length, and rect/circle customize map to Skeleton/Spinner props with StatusSkeleton/StatusSpinner/StatusProgress evidence. The Animate=False static frame maps to prefers-reduced-motion handling; Meter remains a documented product extension.

Closed against the accepted local .fig snapshot (acceptance decision 2026-07-08): the WDS Navigation node contains exactly Category, Tab, Page Indicator, and Pagination, all mapped to LDS props with NavigationTabs/NavigationCompact evidence. TopBar, Footer, SideNav, Steps and related LDS components have no WDS counterpart and are recorded as product extensions; SideNav keeps hover-peek behavior without an invented explicit close pattern.

Closed against the accepted local .fig snapshot (acceptance decision 2026-07-08): Toast severity/leadingIcon/customize, Snackbar heading/description/icon/closeButton/action, and Alert platform x variant x heading map to LDS props with OverlayToast/OverlayConfirmAlert evidence. WDS keeps Snackbar as its own node, matching the separate LDS Snackbar. Alert platform treatments are proven at component level; the platform gallery story is a static visual reference.

Closed against the accepted local .fig snapshot (acceptance decision 2026-07-08): Tooltip Size x Position x Align + shortcut and Menu Variant x Padding x Active x Caption x Disable + actionArea/scroll map to Tooltip/DropdownMenu props with story coverage; check-tooltip-alignment.mjs enforces arrow alignment. The Presentation node contains only Tooltip and Menu, confirming Lightbox/CommandPalette/Popover/HoverCard as product extensions.

knownCoveredFindings.notes: Mobile status bar, home indicator, bottom bar, and bottom action safe-area spacing guidance added after direct Figma screenshot inspection and confirmed by local PDF export.

nextDetailAuditTargets: 1 Theme / 1 Icon: compare assets/icons/manifest.json and ICON_NAMES against the Figma source node.
2 Element / 1 Basic: PDF-confirmed Ratio is mapped; extract remaining Basic subsections and verify color, typography, radius, line, and fill semantics one by one.
2 Element / 3 Decorate: PDF-confirmed Gradient and Interaction are mapped; verify remaining radius, shadow/effect, and decorative treatment examples.
3 Component / 1 Layout: PDF-confirmed Essential and Divider are mapped; verify remaining layout subsections against layout primitives.

3 Component / 2 Action: PDF-confirmed Action Area and Toggle Icon are mapped; verify full WDS Action variants against Button, TextButton, IconButton, Chip, ToggleIcon, ButtonGroup, SplitButton, Fab, and SocialButton.

3 Component / 3 Selection and Input: screenshot confirms Textinput, Select, Control, Segmented Control, and Framed Style groups; local stories cover the visible state matrices through existing LDS components, but exact child-node properties still require Figma node reads.

3 Component / 6 Navigation: PDF-confirmed Category, Tab, Page Indicator, and Pagination are mapped; verify hover-collapse, mobile navigation, footer, menu, tabs, route, stepper, and wizard behavior against stories.
3 Component / 7 Feedback: PDF-confirmed Toast, Snackbar, and Alert are mapped; verify timeout, action, dismissal, and platform behavior against source nodes.
3 Component / 8 Presentation: PDF-confirmed Tooltip and Menu are mapped; verify Tooltip/Menu/Overlay roles and states.
